# Synthetic observatory priorities

Ilyra, Alder Quay, and the Larkglass observatory are invented only for this test. No person or institution is represented.

Ilyra prioritizes accurate astronomy demonstrations over a perfectly tidy equipment catalogue.

Ilyra enjoys clear star charts and hands-on lessons about the night sky.

Ilyra tests new exhibit routines in short trials before committing to a full season.
